race.title: Festive Fiver Raceday 21 December Mares' Novices' Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: This can go the way of LETS GO MO , who shaped encouragingly switched to a handicap after 8 months off when finding just one too strong at Lingfield recently and Lucy Wadham's filly looks capable of better again. Palma Springs represents a yard firing on all cylinders, so she could be the one to provide most resistance, with Bontessony Doll expected to fare better now handicapping over a longer trip. LETS GO MO (IRE) PALMA SPRINGS BONTESSONY DOLL
